backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with all domain types for users, providers, clients, jobs, documents, OTP, and configuration, preparing storage and authorization for the service platform.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to source files, components, and test identifiers.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists short descriptions of key frontend files and their functionality across routing, components, hooks, and UI behavior.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS variables and base styles defining light and dark theme tokens and shared UI properties.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app with PWA metadata and script bootstrapping.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Specifies the IC domain used for canister verification.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, theme colors, and categories.
frontend/public/offline.html: Offline fallback page with basic UI and retry button for PWA offline mode.
frontend/public/sw.js: Versioned service worker handling caching, offline support, cache cleanup, and request routing rules.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app component managing authentication, navigation state, user onboarding, and service worker registration.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, footer, support drawer, and main content area.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button that triggers Internet Identity auth and clears cached queries.
frontend/src/components/auth/PhoneOtpVer: Component for sending and verifying phone OTP codes with validation and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: Guides new authenticated users to select a role and creates an initial profile via actor calls.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders app footer with copyright, support trigger, and caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Top navigation bar handling role‑based nav items, login button, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/landing/DemoVide: Static section displaying a placeholder for an upcoming demo video.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Displays client and provider stats with animated count-up effects and fallback skeletons while loading.
frontend/src/components/landing/RoleQuic: Provides quick role selection with login or navigation handling and visual role cards.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Renders static client testimonials with ratings and provider info.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Offers address and coordinate inputs plus geolocation-based autofill for location data.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Implements a simple messaging UI with message list, send box, and refresh simulation.
frontend/src/components/notifications/En: Shows a temporary dismissible notice indicating provider engagement status.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: Handles M-Pesa payment flow to unlock provider contact details with simulated processing steps.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Renders a provider avatar with fallback initials and size options, handling image load errors.
Displays a grid of demo featured provider cards with avatars, ratings, and basic details.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Shows a provider avatar using a profile picture if available, otherwise initials, with size variants.
Card component for provider listings showing avatar, verification, rate, category, and rating summary.
Modal dialog providing a quick preview of a provider with avatar, verification, ratings, and availability.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: Card prompting users to pay a connection fee to unlock a provider’s contact details.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallPromp: Banner prompting users to install the PWA, with special handling for iOS installation instructions.
frontend/src/components/pwa/UpdateAvaila: Shows a dismissible banner when a service worker update is available, offering a refresh action.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Displays star ratings with support for full, half, and empty stars and formatted rating text.
Renders a 1–5 star rating input using buttons and Lucide icons, supporting readonly and change callbacks.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Implements a drawer UI showing customer support phone and email details with a close button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity, invalidating related queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: Animates a number from start to end when the attached element becomes visible using IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, login handling, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Manages PWA install prompts, iOS detection, and installability state with helpers to trigger install.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for profiles, OTP, location updates, and more.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Detects service worker updates and exposes a method to trigger activation and page reload.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and landing page background styling.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines the Category interface and a list of service categories with IDs, labels, business types, and icons.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ClientAccessPage: Handles client login and account creation using Internet Identity and phone OTP verification.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ProviderAccessPa: Handles service provider login and account creation using Internet Identity and phone OTP verification.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Displays provider verification review UI with a placeholder message and loads the current user profile.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Shows a searchable grid of service categories and navigates to results when a category is selected.
frontend/src/pages/client/ClientProfileP: Displays client profile details and allows updating the pinned location using a LocationPicker and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Shows a placeholder map view page with navigation and a notice that map functionality is not yet available.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Provides a placeholder jobs page where clients will eventually track service requests, with a button to browse services.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Fetches and displays detailed provider info with live polling, ratings, verification status, and unlock/engagement logic.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Displays a provider results list with preview dialog, engagement notices, and navigation to detail or map views.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Renders the landing page with hero content, navigation logic, feature sections, and multiple marketing components.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Allows providers to manage their profile, location, engagement status, and edit mode with validation and update mutations.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Shows provider verification status and placeholders for future document upload functionality.
frontend/src/utils/engagementTime.ts: Utility functions for calculating and formatting remaining engagement time and checking expiration.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Provides functions to compute a 10% connection fee from a bigint rate and to format KES amounts for display.
Manages a pending user role in sessionStorage with validation and helpers to set, get, and clear it.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters (including hash routing), persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing stored values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, typography, container settings, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Tracks project version, architectural notes, known issues, and existing features for the Genz App build state.
